question: Tamil Nadu's Archana Suseendran won how many gold medals at AFI Indian Grand Prix 2 held in Kerala on 27 March 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tamil Nadu's Archana Suseendran **won **2 gold medals** at **AFI Indian Grand Prix 2** held in** Kerala** on 27 March 2023.
 
• Archana Suseendran is an Indian sprinter who specializes in the **100m and 200m **events. 
 
• AFI Indian Grand Prix is an **annual athletics** competition organized by the** Athletics Federation of India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **second leg **of the Indian Grand Prix was held in **Thiruvananthapuram on March 27**, while the third and fourth legs were held in **Bengaluru, Karnataka,** on April 10 and 15, respectively.
 
• There were **eighteen events** in the inaugural Grand Prix, with** ten **for men and **ten **for women.
 
• **Men's** events featured **shot put, javelin throw, long jump, triple jump, high jump, **200, 800, and 5,000 meters, as well as 400 meters of hurdles.
 
• **Long jump, high jump, shot put**, 200, 800, 5,000, and 400-meter hurdle events were all open to **women.**
